sideA.name: Aisha
sideA.account: I muted the family group chat for a year because it got about 400 good-morning images a week. Muting it was self-care, and anything important should have been a phone call.

sideB.name: Rohan
sideB.account: The reunion moved to a new restaurant and we announced it in the chat a week ahead. Aisha went to the old place, sat alone for an hour, and then blamed the chat instead of the mute button.

agreedFacts: The family group chat was muted for about a year.
The new reunion venue was announced only in the group chat, one week before the date.
